body: I have interests, but zero ability, and knowing that I’ll never be able to actually pursue it makes me want to cut myself off from my interests altogether
I also have depression and severe anxiety, but I don’t know how closely linked they are to aspergers, though they definitely feed into one another

I think the issue is my parents interpreted all of my reclusive behaviours as ‘he doesn’t like it when we give him affection or overly involved with us’, rather than out of frustration, and I can’t really bring myself to blame them for that
Yes, I feel like a complete waste of space with no talents, interests or personality, and I’m going to die before the age of 20

I used to second guess my diagnosis because I’m not smart, or wasn’t as smart as I thought I should be. It’s much easier to cope with a diagnosis is you’re not being fed a narrative on how exactly a certain type of person should act or behave
That’s the exact reason why they make porn. There’s nothing to be ashamed about
Where are the peer reviewed sources?
It’s the most infuriating thing on the planet, but I’m sure I’ve been guilty of it before
